commit.messageHeadline: feat(update): let the candidate decide update admission
test(update): prove candidate admission in first-hop updates
fix(update): preserve admission startup and stage ownership
chore(update): reconcile admission with current updater
test(update): compare runtime previews with installed admission
test(update): assemble the credential fixture URL at runtime
fix(update): keep Node runtime recovery with the installed updater
fix(update): accept candidate Node engine facts in the update-run schema
test(update): split the admission test support module
test(update): return an explicit value from the admission npm fixture
chore(update): merge current main for candidate admission
refactor(update): pass the admission context by argument
